t: Color Changing — How it works — the physics
description: Signature edition. Color Changing (Plasma Amor Grade): How it works — the physics. Color-changing garments use thermochromic, electrochromic, or photochromic materials to shift hue with temperature, voltage, or light. Real versions exist; full-spectrum camouflage does not. content.overview: Color-changing garments use thermochromic, electrochromic, or photochromic materials to shift hue with temperature, voltage, or light. Real versions exist; full-spectrum camouflage does not. Plasma Amor Grade: real chemistry plus the plasma-amor color lattice concept (labeled).
details: Leuco dyes are molecular switches: heat breaks the colored complex into a colorless form, reversibly.
Liquid crystals reflect color by helical pitch; temperature changes the pitch and the reflected wavelength.
Electrochromics move ions in and out of a metal-oxide film under voltage, changing its absorption.
All three trade speed, range, and durability: fast and vivid is rarely washable, washable is rarely vivid.

details: Pick the trigger: body heat (thermochromic), battery (electrochromic), or sunlight (photochromic).
